messages:
nora: Heads up — acme is seeing a spike of 5xxs for model `redwood-3b` in eu-west-1 over the past hour. Any quick saved-search or dashboard I should run before I dig deeper?
kevin: quick answer: LogSearch dashboard has a preset for errors but for route-level drilling use this query in LogSearch: `service:redwood-runtime AND route:"/v2/generate" AND model:"redwood-3b" AND region:eu-west-1 AND status:[500 TO 599]` then set the time to Last 60m.
ops-bot: Alert triggered: `route-5xx-eu` @ 2026-06-12T12:14:23Z — firing 14m, value=12 (threshold 10).
jing: paste the query below if you want the exact filter to save as a preset. I also added a small tweak to include org filtering: `service:redwood-runtime AND org_id:acme AND model:"redwood-3b" AND route:"/v2/generate" AND region:eu-west-1 AND status:[500 TO 599]`
jing: to save in the UI: open Logs -> run query -> click "Save query" -> name it `sre/route-5xx-acme-redwood-3b-eu` and set visibility to org or team. Or via API: `curl -X POST https://logs.redwood.ai/api/v1/saved-queries -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"name":"sre/route-5xx-acme-redwood-3b-eu","query":"<paste query>","team":"sre"}'`
sam: also recommend lowering the alert window to 5m rolling and switch from absolute count to % error-rate for that route. Right now it's counting hosts across regions which is noisy. Example alert expression: `sum(last_5m):errors(route:"/v2/generate",org_id:acme)/sum(last_5m):requests(route:"/v2/generate",org_id:acme) > 0.02`
rachel: traces: i grabbed one trace id for a failed request: `trace: 8b3f2a9c` — open APM -> Traces -> search that id. Looks like tail-end timeout in the model node (kv cache miss + cpu fallback).
nora: got it, thanks. @jing can you save the query and share the link here? I'll add to incident notes + runbook.
jing: done — saved as `sre/route-5xx-acme-redwood-3b-eu` and shared link: https://dash.redwood.ai/logs/saved/sre%2Froute-5xx-acme-redwood-3b-eu :thumbsup:
kevin: pushed a quick dashboard panel to the SRE -> Route Errors board for that saved search. Panel ID: 42.
sam: filing a follow-up to tune alert config (SRE-599). Assigning to @kevin for config + to @rachel for trace follow-up.
nora: perfect. tagging @ops-bot to make sure the alert has the right escalation chain.
ops-bot: Acknowledged. Escalation: oncall -> oncall-2 -> eng-sre.
nora: thanks all — i'll monitor for the next 30m and update ops channel if it persists. :eyes:
